description: Use this when the user wants to run a White Elephant, Yankee Swap, or Dirty Santa gift game: shuffles a fair random turn order for 3 to 60 players and writes the rules (steal limit per gift, optional cap on steals per turn, no immediate steal-backs, player 1's final swap), with a printable PDF (Letter or A4) that includes a gift tracker and a printable web page. Does not run the game live or track steals. Do not use for Secret Santa name draws (use plan_gift_exchange).

event_name.description: Name printed on the rules sheet, e.g. Team White Elephant 2026.

first_player_final_swap.description: true (default) = player 1 gets a final turn to swap with any unfrozen gift, since they never had a chance to steal.

max_steals_per_turn.description: Optional cap on steals in one turn's chain, e.g. 2. Omit for no cap.

no_immediate_steal_back.description: true (default) = you cannot steal back the gift that was just taken from you.

paper.description: PDF paper size: letter (default) or a4, e.g. a4.

participants.description: Everyone playing (3 to 60 people), e.g. ["Ana","Bo","Cy","Dee","Eli","Fay","Gus","Hal"]. Names must be unique.

steal_limit.description: How many times one gift can be stolen before it is frozen, e.g. 3 (default). 0 turns stealing off.

name: plan_white_elephant
title: Plan White Elephant game
